title: Flash/Flex Developer
summary: Leading development of a widget framework for Shoutlet.com. I created a lightweight framework based on Flex (MXML based, Box layout, etc) that was significantly smaller in file size (10x) without compromising on skinning, MVC/Cairngorm, and layout power. This has allowed Shoutlet to reinvent existing movie and podcast widgets and expand into more complex widgets utilizing multimedia messaging, Twitter, and FormSpring. My widget builder was featured on Flex.org.
